hebrew:
הַלְלוּ־יָהּ אוֹדֶה ה׳ בְּכָל־לֵבָב בְּסוֹד יְשָׁרִים וְעֵדָה׃
גְּדֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂי ה׳ דְּרוּשִׁים לְכָל־חֶפְצֵיהֶם׃
הוֹד־וְהָדָר פָּעֳלוֹ וְצִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃
זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם ה׳׃
טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ׃
כֹּחַ מַעֲשָׂיו הִגִּיד לְעַמּוֹ לָתֵת לָהֶם נַחֲלַת גּוֹיִם׃
מַעֲשֵׂי יָדָיו אֱמֶת וּמִשְׁפָּט נֶאֱמָנִים כָּל־פִּקּוּדָיו׃
סְמוּכִים לָעַד לְעוֹלָם עֲשׂוּיִים בֶּאֱמֶת וְיָשָׁר׃
פְּדוּת שָׁלַח לְעַמּוֹ צִוָּה לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא שְׁמוֹ׃
רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת ה׳ שֵׂכֶל טוֹב לְכָל־עֹשֵׂיהֶם תְּהִלָּתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד

translation:
Hallelujah! I will praise the Lord with all my heart, in the company of the upright and the assembly.
Great are the works of the Lord; they are worthy of all praise.
His works are majestic and glorious; His righteousness endures forever.
He has made a memorial of His wonders; the Lord is gracious and merciful.
He has given the spoil to those who fear Him; He will remember His covenant forever.
He has made known to His people the power of His deeds, to give them the inheritance of the nations.
The works of His hands are truth, and all His commandments are faithful justice.
They stand firm forever and ever; they are established in truth and uprightness.
He sent redemption to His people; He commanded His covenant forever; His name is holy and awesome.
The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; good understanding is found in all who practice it; His praise endures forever.
